supersedes_only: The duration and minimum-sample stopping rule of the shadow coordinator; the frozen fingerprint and control semantics are unchanged.
source_boundary_rule: Count only complete source-partition pairs whose first partition begins at or after the first whole UTC hour following the shadow boundary; older partitions are excluded even if processed later.
stopping_rule: Stop at the first point when 24 wall-clock hours have elapsed and at least 500 complete fresh control windows have been recorded. Continue to 72 hours only if the minimum sample has not been reached or a longer descriptive run is explicitly requested.
rationale: A 24-hour fresh shadow with a predeclared minimum complete-control sample is sufficient for this exploratory specificity check; the prior 2,473 complete historical controls remain a separate descriptive baseline. This amendment is made before any observations from the new shadow boundary are included.
validation_status: No profitability or trading validation is established by this shadow run.
